runtimeEscalation.reason: External checkout and Unity behavior require separate explicit authorization.

caseAssertions.normal-input: required Skill files and persistent map are present
caseAssertions.invalid-input: missing or malformed source inputs are rejected
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: protected target and external side effects remain denied
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: same map revision yields stable output
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: source or target drift marks mapping stale
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: interrupted batch preserves target and recovery state
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: stable sorting and partitioning are declared
caseAssertions.identity-hardening: compound root fragments are remapped in text, paths and filenames without double-prefixing
caseAssertions.developer-branding: package developer metadata and legacy author seeds converge on the canonical ES studio identity
caseAssertions.recovery-phase-authority: journal phase determines whether missing staging is safely recoverable or fail-closed
caseAssertions.snapshot-locator-boundary: handoff consumes immutable private snapshot paths and receipts do not persist mutable absolute source paths
caseAssertions.binary-license-runtime-separation: binary preservation, license boundaries, and Static versus Runtime evidence remain separate

responsibilityScope: Static acceptance for direct external-checkout ES naming: input and permission boundaries, deterministic whole-repository replacement, interruption recovery, and evidence receipts. It does not authorize Git-history mutation, Unity execution, or release behavior.

specializedAcceptance.title: isolated external migration static gate
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static acceptance proves contracts and deterministic checks only; external checkout execution, Unity and release behavior remain unverified.
